messages:
auditor_lee: Quick fieldwork request for INC-6164123456 — we need a one-page control pack for SOC2 that proves: RBAC rollback/remediation timeline (who acted, what changed, when), KMS rotation and cryptographic linkage showing post-rotation ciphertexts reference the new key version, an immutable snapshot of artifacts with checksums and a signed manifest, and the vuln triage notes that produced the fixes. Please point to exact files and paste short audit queries.

ellie: We can deliver a single proof bundle. High-level artifacts will be: terraform plan/apply diff (redacted), CloudTrail/CloudAudit events for IAM role changes, KMS key metadata + CloudTrail Encrypt/ReEncrypt entries, S3 WORM copy + .sha256 file + GPG-signed manifest, and INC-6164123456/triage.md. Paths: s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6164123456/{terraform-diff.txt, iam-events.json.gz, kms-events.jsonl, bundle.tar.gz, bundle.tar.gz.sha256, manifest.json.sig, triage.md}.

muthu: RBAC specifics: rolebinding was removed via terraform at 2025-03-14T09:04:22Z. Remote state shows the apply diff; we exported the plan/apply output to s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6164123456/terraform-diff.txt (secrets redacted). CloudTrail query we used: 
```
lookup eventName=DetachRolePolicy OR eventName=DeleteRolePolicy | where eventTime >= 2025-03-14T09:00:00Z and eventTime <= 2025-03-14T09:10:00Z
```
Matches were exported to iam-events.json.gz with event ids: 0a9f5c2b-... and 1b2e3d4f-...

ellie: KMS rotation: we promoted cryptoKeyVersion 4 as primary at 2025-03-14T09:12:03Z. CloudTrail Encrypt/ReEncrypt entries include requestParameters.destinationKeyVersionId and ciphertext metadata has x-amz-meta-kms-key-version:4 for post-rotation uploads. We exported related events to kms-events.jsonl. Short CloudTrail snippet: 
```
{ eventName in (Encrypt, ReEncrypt) and requestParameters.destinationKeyVersionId endswith ":4" and eventTime >= 2025-03-14T09:12:00Z }
```
Sample ciphertext header we captured (redacted): 
```
-----CIPHERTEXT-ENVELOPE-----
x-amz-meta-kms-key-arn: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789
x-amz-meta-kms-key-version: 4
-----END ENVELOPE-----
```
This will demonstrate cryptographic linkage to version 4.

logs-bot: auto-export: uploaded s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6164123456/iam-events.json.gz (sha256: b7f2c8...); s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6164123456/kms-events.jsonl (sha256: d1e4aa...); s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6164123456/terraform-diff.txt (sha256: 9c3b7f...); manifest.json.sig stored at s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6164123456/manifest.json.sig (signed-by: ops@redwood.com).

ops-sig-bot: Signed manifest details: GPG key fingerprint 3F4A 7B2C 9E01 D4F2 6A9B C0D1 2345 6789 A1B2 C3D4 (key id 0xA1B2C3D4). manifest.json includes filename list + sha256 checksums for each object and a signed timestamp 2025-03-14T10:05:00Z. Presigned GETs created (7d expiry) for auditor package: 
- manifest: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence/incidents/6164123456/manifest.json.sig?X
- bundle: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence/incidents/6164123456/bundle.tar.gz?X
- terraform-diff: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence/incidents/6164123456/terraform-diff.txt?X

ellie: Snapshot/retention: bundle.tar.gz was copied to redwood-worm bucket using Object Lock in Governance mode with a 365-day retention policy at copy time. The ascii checksum is stored as bundle.tar.gz.sha256 next to the object. We also preserved object metadata on the copy; the x-amz-meta-kms-key-version header was retained on the archived copy.

muthu: Vulnerability triage: INC-6164123456 notes are in triage.md. Short summary: CVE-2025-0421 found in base image redwood/serving:2.7; risk assessment elevated to high; mitigation = rebuild base image v2.7.1 + rolling restart; remediation applied at 2025-03-14T09:45:00Z. Deploy logs exported to s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6164123456/deploy-log.txt.gz.

auditor_lee: Two clarifications: 1) For RBAC we need the exact terraform apply timestamp and the plan diff output that shows the removal. 2) For KMS we need a decrypted-log entry or envelope that shows ciphertexts written after promotion reference key version 4 (not just the setPrimary API). Can you paste a single small redacted CloudTrail event and a terraform diff snippet here?

ellie: Terraform snippet (redacted): 
```
- resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "svcacct_attach" {
-   role       = "svc-pod-readonly"
-   policy_arn = "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess"
- }
+ (removed)
apply timestamp: 2025-03-14T09:04:22Z
```
CloudTrail event (redacted, one entry): 
```
{
  eventTime: 2025-03-14T09:12:05Z,
  eventName: "Encrypt",
  requestParameters: { destinationKeyVersionId: "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789:4" }
}
```
This satisfies the auditor's ask for ciphertext linkage to version 4.

ops-sig-bot: Verification steps we'll provide in control pack: 1) download manifest.json.sig, verify signature with ops public key (fingerprint above) using gpg --verify; 2) download bundle.tar.gz and compute sha256sum and compare to bundle.tar.gz.sha256; 3) check kms-events.jsonl for Encrypt/ReEncrypt entries with destinationKeyVersionId ending in :4; 4) paste terraform-diff.txt showing the RBAC removal and match timestamps to cloud audit events.

auditor_lee: Excellent. Final ask: produce the one-page control map (plain text) with these fields — Control ID, Incident ID, What was changed, Evidence files (with presigned links), Exact audit queries used, Retention + WORM details, Cryptographic assertions (GPG fingerprint + KMS key ARN+version), Redaction notes, Owner and contact. Please post it here so I can drop into the SOC2 binder.

ellie: On it — will post the control map in ~15 minutes with the presigned links and exact short queries. Leaving thread open for the control map. Thanks everyone.
